correctness.rationale: All twenty standard golden-ratio vertex coordinates are antipodally paired. Central-section vertices correspond exactly to edges with opposite normal signs. In actual check.py, exact ordered Q(sqrt5) arithmetic classifies feasible sign chambers of ten vertex-pair great circles; no three intersect concurrently, yielding exactly 92 cells: twenty spherical hexagons with six crossed edges, sixty triangles with eight, twelve pentagons with ten. Each class has respectively spherical excess 2pi-3a-3b, 2a+b-pi, 2pi-5a (a=acos(1/3), b=acos(sqrt5/3)). Weighted by 20,60,12 and divided by 4pi, give all probabilities .638408811559..., .238989468900..., .122601719541..., summing to one. Independently counted crossed edges for 250000 sampled normal vectors: fractions 0.636852,0.240176,0.122972. Sampling checks only, exact finite chamber classification is the exhaustive certificate. Boundary great circles measure zero.
